Rates with confidence intervals by group

Source: R/summaries.R
phw_rate_table.Rd

Rates per population (e.g. per 100,000) with exact Poisson confidence intervals, for one or more grouping variables such as age group, sex, deprivation quintile or risk factor. With several grouping variables, each one becomes a section with its own heading, as in a demographic breakdown of infection rates.

Usage

phw_rate_table(
  data,
  groups,
  cases,
  population,
  per = 1e+05,
  conf_level = 0.95,
  digits = 1,
  labels = list(),
  total = TRUE,
  rate_label = NULL
)

Arguments

data

Aggregated data: one row per group (or finer), with columns of case counts and population. Rows are summed within each group.

groups

Grouping columns, chosen as in dplyr::select(), e.g. c(age_group, sex). Each gets its own section.

cases, population

Columns holding counts and denominators, unquoted as in dplyr. Strings work too.

per

Rate multiplier, e.g. 1e5 for per 100,000.

conf_level

Confidence level for the intervals.

digits

Decimal places for rates.

labels

Named list of display names for the grouping columns.

total

Add an overall row at the top?

rate_label

Heading for the rate column. Defaults to "Rate per 100,000" (or whatever per is).

Value

A phw_summary data frame with numeric Cases, Population and Rate columns and a text confidence interval column.

Details

Intervals use the exact (Garwood) method based on the chi-square distribution, which works for small counts, including zero.

Examples

d <- expand.grid(age_group = c("0-14", "15-44", "45-64", "65+"),
                 sex = c("Female", "Male"))
d$cases <- c(12, 30, 41, 66, 10, 28, 45, 70)
d$pop <- c(250, 600, 400, 300, 260, 590, 390, 260) * 1000
phw_rate_table(d, c(age_group, sex), cases, pop,
               labels = list(age_group = "Age group", sex = "Sex"))
#>      Group Cases Population Rate per 100,000       95% CI
#>      Total   302    3050000              9.9  8.8 to 11.1
#>  Age group    NA         NA               NA             
#>       0-14    22     510000              4.3   2.7 to 6.5
#>      15-44    58    1190000              4.9   3.7 to 6.3
#>      45-64    86     790000             10.9  8.7 to 13.4
#>        65+   136     560000             24.3 20.4 to 28.7
#>        Sex    NA         NA               NA             
#>     Female   149    1550000              9.6  8.1 to 11.3
#>       Male   153    1500000             10.2  8.6 to 12.0
#> Confidence intervals use the exact Poisson method.
